tagline: Alberto Trevisan approaches life as if it were a flawed manuscript requiring rigorous correction
bio: Alberto Trevisan stands as Venice's preeminent methodological philosopher, whose relentless pursuit of empirical truth has revolutionized how the Republic evaluates knowledge. As chancellor to Venice's scientific institutions and a recent initiate of the prestigious Triumvirate Sapientiae, Alberto has cultivated a reputation for intellectual precision that borders on the merciless.
